prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone landscape 16:9 pure artwork for card 1003010050, Yggdrasil & Fate / 世界树与命运, type ensemble.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: horizontal series finale cover, Yggdrasil as the dominant central world-axis, small Norns and sun-moon elements secondary, broad calm background, no character collage.

Visual thesis: 世界树为绝对一级视觉中心，诺恩与日月只做小比例次级层级。

Visual continuity entities: yggdrasil；urd；verdandi；skuld；sol；mani；skoll；hati；nidhoggr.

Canonical image references required for identity/landmark matching: 1003010020；1003010009；1003010010；1003010011；1003010012；1003010013；1003010014；1003010015；1003010016. These references control recurring face, age, silhouette, palette, material, and landmark geometry; they do not control camera or pose.

Source-bound continuity facts: yggdrasil: A vast ash tree.；yggdrasil: It is evergreen.；yggdrasil: It has three great roots extending in three directions.；yggdrasil: Urðr's well and the Norns are associated with the tree.

MythCanvas locked continuity design: yggdrasil: One colossal twisted central trunk remains unified through the lower two thirds and divides only in the upper third into three principal crown leaders.；yggdrasil: A broad asymmetrical umbrella crown uses small deep desaturated evergreen ash leaflets; foliage never becomes white leaves or blossoms.；yggdrasil: Pale dew, frost, or snow may edge the foliage but may not recolor the crown.；yggdrasil: Three massive buttress roots diverge visibly from the same trunk system.；yggdrasil: Bark is charcoal brown with long vertical silver fissures and restrained moss only on water-facing surfaces.；yggdrasil: No luminous blue veins, floating cities, realm bubbles, or labeled nine-world diagram.；urd: Young adult with pale-blond braided hair, dark green and weathered ivory garments, calm retrospective bearing; not an elderly crone.；verdandi: Young adult with warm light-brown wavy hair, pale gray-green garments, fluid present-tense gesture, and open attentive expression.；skuld: Young adult with dark hair, charcoal garments, alert forward-looking expression, and the sharpest silhouette of the three Norns.；sol: Golden-blond active charioteer with the same youthful face, ivory-gold garments, and restrained sun-disc browpiece as card 1003010012.；sol: Never red-haired and never redesigned as a heavily armored fantasy queen.；mani: Silver-haired youthful male with cool gray skin light, charcoal-blue garments, narrow moon ornament, and quiet inward posture.；skoll: Lean ash-gray wolf with long running silhouette and pale amber eyes, always assigned to the sun pursuit.；hati: Heavier charcoal wolf with broad shoulders and cold blue-gray eyes, always assigned to the moon pursuit.；nidhoggr: Long root-clinging dark serpent-dragon with reduced limbs or no visible wings, rough bark-like scales, and a gnawing jaw built for roots.；nidhoggr: Never a winged fire-breathing game dragon.

Identity anchors: 无额外条目

Must keep: 无额外条目

Must avoid: 无额外条目

Composition: camera clear subject-first camera; shot single readable composition; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Series-wide visual grammar: keep matte painterly surfaces；broad readable forms；limited focal sharpness；quiet atmospheric negative space；restrained blue-white frost and ember light；subject detail clearly stronger than background detail; avoid glossy game-CG rendering；hyper-detailed-everything；generic Viking cosplay；floating realm platforms；science-fiction orbit graphics；random glowing runes；multiple competing focal centers.

Color and material guidance: palette 无额外条目; materials 无额外条目; mood 无额外条目.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 无额外条目. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: typography；logo；card frame；watermark；character collage；equal-detail-everywhere；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete landscape 16:9 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 2880x1620 pixels.
